note: Round-6 additions: RECENT ONCOLOGY patents only, priority dates 2011-2024, one or two per modern oncology scaffold class. Same schema as pdf_corpus_round4_manifest.json. source_url is provenance, not a required fetch - the PDFs are committed under benchmarks/corpus/ with SHA256SUMS. n_expected counts the distinct compounds this manifest catalogues, resolved plus generic plus unresolved; n_resolved counts those carrying a PubChem CID. est_structures is the total number of DEPICTIONS on the pages and is much larger; for five documents it is a flagged estimate, see pdf_manifest_round6.json `count_caveat`. Every CID was resolved from something PRINTED IN THE DOCUMENT and then CHECKED against the drawing.
retrieval_note: The round-4 routes have both degraded. patents.google.com now returns HTTP 503 to curl AND to a server-side fetcher, and https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/pdfs/US<number>.pdf now returns 403 AccessDenied for modern numbers (US10519146, US9260416) while still serving the old ones round 4 used (US7326708 still returns 200). USPTO image-ppubs, Espacenet and Justia all return 403. Two routes DO work. (a) EPO publication server, unauthenticated, for any granted EP: https://data.epo.org/publication-server/rest/v1.2/patents/EP<number>NW<kind>/document.pdf - B1 only, an A1 request returns HTTP 500. (b) A read-through proxy with an HTML return format reaches Google Patents where curl cannot: `curl -H 'X-Return-Format: html' https://r.jina.ai/https://patents.google.com/patent/<ID>/en` returns the full page including the HASHED patentimages URL, and that hashed URL is then fetchable by plain curl. The same proxy reaches patents.google.com/xhr/query, which is how the candidates were searched. LESSON: a web-search summary is not a patent number. 'EP2989196B1' was returned as the zanubrutinib patent and is in fact NOUVELLE ALGUE RADIORESISTANTE DU GENRE COCCOMYXA. Every number below was verified by fetching the document and reading its own title page.

accepted.title: EP 2 736 895 B1, Butterworth, Finlay, Ward et al., AstraZeneca AB, filed 2012-07-25 (priority 2011-07-27), granted 2016-01-06, "2-(2,4,5-substituted-anilino) pyrimidine derivatives as EGFR modulators useful for treating cancer" - the osimertinib (TAGRISSO) compound and mesylate-polymorph patent, from PCT/GB2012/051783 (WO 2013/014448)
accepted.licence: Published European patent specification, public record
accepted.structure_pages: Markush formulae (I)-(VI) pp3-7; Example 26 p27; the Example 28 (osimertinib) schemes p28; the mesylate salt p29; Example 59 p37; Intermediates pp50, 58, 65, 69, 74-77; three large claim depictions pp79-81. NON-STRUCTURE figures pp83-103: 21 full-page XRPD patterns and DSC/TGA thermograms, one per page
accepted.why: The EGFR/covalent-acrylamide stratum, and the round's cleanest example of a document that mixes three depiction classes at scale: six Markush formulae, twenty specific scheme structures and twenty-one instrument plots. It also poses the SALT question in a form no earlier corpus document does - the mesylate is drawn as an ION PAIR, base-H+ and CH3SO3-, not as a neutral two-component adduct, so a faithful reading does not match PubChem's record for the salt. The INN never appears; the compound is 'Compound X' and a full IUPAC name, which is exactly the naming style that defeats a name-based shortcut.
accepted.drawing_style: EPO B1 specification (JOUVE typesetting, Acrobat Distiller 7.0): vector A4 text with every structure inserted as a 300-dpi CCITT bitonal clipping. 25 structure clippings on pp3-81 plus 21 full-page 2165x1547 instrument-plot stencils on pp83-103

accepted.title: EP 3 630 761 B1, Amgen Inc., filed 2018-05-21 (priority 2017-05-22), "KRAS G12C inhibitors and methods of using the same" - the sotorasib (LUMAKRAS/LUMYKRAS) compound patent, from WO 2018/217651
accepted.licence: Published European patent specification, public record

accepted.why: The KRAS G12C stratum and the corpus's first ATROPISOMER test. Claims 3-6 claim 'Atropisomer 1' and 'Atropisomer 2' as separate inventions and draw them with PIXEL-IDENTICAL 2D structures - the axial chirality exists only in the claim wording. No OCSR tool can pass that, and no SMILES reference can encode it, which makes it a clean measurement of a hard ceiling. It is also the round's most efficient document: 26 pages, 407 KB, a complete named seven-step route, thirteen resolvable compounds. Third asset: p12 embeds 25 copies of one 63x61 raster that is a punctuation glyph in a list of cancer types, so a naive image-per-page structure count reports 25 phantom structures on a page with none.
accepted.drawing_style: EPO B1 specification (Callas pdfaPilot / Acrobat Distiller 7.0): vector A4 text with structures as 300-dpi CCITT bitonal clippings. 34 structure clippings; the claims are printed three times (EN/DE/FR) and each language repeats all 8 structure-bearing claims

accepted.title: US 12,011,442 B2, Clifton H. Hamilton, Macfarlan Smith Limited (Edinburgh), filed 2020-10-08, granted 2024-06-18, "Solid-state forms of abemaciclib, their use and preparation"
accepted.structure_pages: ONE 2D structure, inline on p11 in the Background. Nine drawing sheets pp2-10 carry no 2D chemistry
accepted.why: The negative control for figure-class discrimination, and a harder one than PMC12548288 (which simply has no figures). This document has NINE numbered drawing sheets and exactly ONE 2D structure. Eight sheets are XRPD, DSC, TGA, DVS and a sorption isotherm; p4 is a polarised-light photomicrograph of crystals; and p3 - the trap - is a THREE-DIMENSIONAL ball-and-stick single-crystal structure of abemaciclib with its methanol of solvation. That is genuinely a molecular depiction, just not a 2D one, and its methanol is not part of the claimed compound. 14 pages and 937 KB, so it costs almost nothing to run.

accepted.title: WO 2021/259732 A1, filed 2021-06-16 (priority 2020-06-23), published 2021-12-30, "Multi-component compounds comprising zanubrutinib and a benzoic acid derivative", PCT/EP2021/066261
accepted.structure_pages: Formula (I) p4; Formula (II) p11; Formula (IIa) p12; Formula (IIb) p19; the claim Formula (II) p40. NON-STRUCTURE: 16 figure sheets pp43-58 including two 3D ORTEP renderings (Figures 11-12, pp53-54) and a manufacturing FLOWCHART (Figure 16, p58); pp59-60 are the International Search Report
accepted.why: The BTK stratum, and the corpus's first VARIABLE-STOICHIOMETRY test. The claimed compound is zanubrutinib with a benzoic acid derivative in a ratio n of 0.8 to 1.2, and the hydrate adds a second independent subscript m. A two-component SMILES asserts exactly 1:1, which the document explicitly does not, so the co-crystal itself is unscoreable while its three components are individually clean. It also stacks three non-2D figure classes in one file - ORTEP, process flowchart and a bound-in search report.
accepted.drawing_style: WIPO A1 publication (PDF::API2): every page is one full-page bitonal raster with NO text layer - pdftotext returns 0 characters. Vector-quality ChemDraw art rasterised at page resolution; hashed-wedge stereo

accepted.title: WO 2017/215166 A1, filed 2016-10-19 (priority 2016-06-13), published 2017-12-21, "Synthesis of PARP inhibitor talazoparib", PCT/CN2016/102594
accepted.structure_pages: Formula 1 p2; two PRIOR-ART routes pp3-4 (from WO 2010/017055 and WO 2015/069851); the invention's route p5; the same route restated pp8-12; claims p21. pp24-26 are the International Search Report
accepted.why: The PARP stratum and the round's best STEREO test. Every stereocentre is drawn twice over - once as a bold or hashed wedge and once as a printed CIP letter beside it, '(S)' or '(R)' - and the drawing's letters agree with the (8S,9R) of the printed name. Better still, it contains a live ChemDraw ARTEFACT: a '(Z)' descriptor stamped on ring bonds inside the aromatic 1-methyl-1,2,4-triazole. Those are meaningless double-bond descriptors on a five-membered aromatic ring, and a tool that honours them emits a molecule that cannot exist. Twenty-six pages, and its stereo pair 16/17 differ by nothing but one wedge.
accepted.drawing_style: WIPO A1 publication (PDF::API2), Chinese-origin PCT/CN2016/102594 in English: every page is one full-page bitonal raster with NO text layer - pdftotext returns 0 characters. ChemDraw art with bold/hashed wedges AND printed CIP letters beside the stereocentres

accepted.title: CN 114085213 A, Suzhou Guokuang Pharmtech Co. Ltd, filed 2022-01-20, published 2022-02-25, "\u4e00\u79cdARV-471\u7684\u5236\u5907\u65b9\u6cd5" (A method for preparing ARV-471) - the vepdegestrant PROTAC
accepted.licence: Published Chinese (CNIPA) patent application, public record
accepted.structure_pages: 48 structure clippings spread over pp1-22; two clippings per page (116x17 and 160x18) are the page header and footer stamps, not chemistry
accepted.why: The PROTAC/degrader stratum, and by molecular size the hardest document in the round: vepdegestrant is C45H49N5O4, 54 heavy atoms, a tetrahydronaphthalene ER ligand joined through a piperidine-piperazine linker to a cereblon-binding glutarimide isoindolinone, with three stereocentres. It also draws two DIFFERENT salt-forming acids as separate species, benzenesulfonic acid on the cereblon ligand and D-tartaric acid on the penultimate intermediate, and its header/footer stamps are a built-in false-positive trap for any per-page image counter.

It also distinguishes the free base from the marketed dihydrochloride by nothing but the condensed text '2HCl' beside the structure, which is the minimal possible salt cue.

accepted.title: US 9,463,252 B2, Senter, Donna and Bovee, Seattle Genetics Inc., filed 2013-10-23, granted 2016-10-11, "Auristatin drug linker conjugates"
accepted.structure_pages: PAGES KEPT, not the whole grant. Extracted with `mutool merge ... 1-11,20-28,41-44,60-62` from the 63-page original: pp1-2 front page and references, pp3-11 all nine drawing sheets, pp20-28 Formula (I) and the substituent-fragment pages, pp41-44 the solid-phase schemes, pp60-62 the claims. 6.63 MB reduced to 1.71 MB
accepted.why: THE MARKUSH STRATUM, deliberately. Not one depiction in this patent is a fully specified molecule, and that is the point: it is the corpus's cleanest measurement of whether a tool knows a Markush from a molecule. Three separate non-molecule classes are present - the Formula (I) auristatin skeleton with twelve R-groups, roughly 45 substituent-fragment sketches drawn with SQUIGGLY OPEN VALENCES, and solid-phase intermediates whose C-terminus ends in a SHADED CIRCLE meaning resin bead with AA1(x)/AA2(y) placeholders mid-chain. MMAE and MMAF are defined in words in the abbreviations list and never drawn without a variable. The nine drawing sheets are pharmacology curves. Score it for false positives only.
accepted.drawing_style: USPTO grant scan (ImageMagick 6.9.0 raster) WITH a poor-quality invisible OCR layer - pdftotext returns text, but it garbles subscripts and superscripts ('R" and R' for R4 and R5, 'C-Cs' for C1-C8). 1990s-2000s ChemDraw art of very long linear peptidic molecules

Second, p41 draws Compound P with NUMBERED ATOM POSITIONS printed on the skeleton, a depiction convention that puts stray digits inside the structure box.
